about: Optional MiBoX artwork: theme materials, brand marks, 320 named atlas tiles, signal-flow and help illustrations, plus Android launcher assets. Atlas names and order are documented in asset_catalog.json; every slot is licensed original CC0 artwork.
licence_policy: CC0-1.0 or another public-domain dedication. Do not commit a file whose licence is missing, non-commercial, or unclear. Fill in licence, source and author when a file is added.
